classifications.tagged-root: tagged Lisp reference updated by the collector
classifications.raw-address: raw wasm32 address, rederived after movement where interior
classifications.bounded: bounded index or count, never a tagged value
classifications.atomic-state: accessed only with sequentially consistent atomics
classifications.code-identifier: logical code ID or entry kind

owners.collector: the collection owner while the thread is stopped or admitted
owners.host: the host through stable request storage only

fields.name: tcr_index
fields.description: index into the process-wide TCR registry; a different namespace from any symbol binding index
fields.update: written once at publication by the admitted creator

fields.name: worker_id
fields.description: owning Worker identity

fields.name: lifetime_generation
fields.description: TCR lifetime generation; advanced before storage reuse, exhaustion refused, never compared by parity
fields.update: registry advances under admission; reclamation requires a completed collection and terminal host outcomes

fields.name: registry_next
fields.description: next TCR in the registry list
fields.update: admitted creator or collector under D5 membership closure

fields.name: registry_prev
fields.description: previous TCR in the registry list

fields.name: tcr_address
fields.description: this record's own address; the current-TCR selector is instance-private, never a shared C global

fields.name: state
fields.description: CREATING, PARKED, RUNNING, FOREIGN, STOPPED_GC or TERMINATING; the probe-then-load admission store
fields.update: owning thread stores; collector loads; sequentially consistent

fields.name: pending
fields.description: GC and INTERRUPT bits; unrelated bits preserved by every update
fields.update: collector sets GC; interrupter sets INTERRUPT; the thread claims and clears its own bits atomically

fields.name: stop_generation
fields.description: gc_gen value observed at the last STOPPED_GC record, for wait expectation and diagnostics

fields.name: alloc_pointer
fields.description: next free byte of the owned allocation area

fields.name: alloc_limit
fields.description: end of the owned allocation area; the slow path checks capacity here
fields.update: collector or allocator on area assignment while the thread is stopped or admitted

fields.name: alloc_base
fields.description: start of the owned allocation area

fields.name: allocation_quantum_log2
fields.description: log2 of the allocation quantum

fields.name: vsp
fields.description: value stack pointer; grows upward; B places every Lisp argument here
fields.update: generated code; checkpointed by every frame

fields.name: vsp_base
fields.description: owned value-stack region start

fields.name: vsp_limit
fields.description: owned value-stack region end; explicit bound, no guard page

fields.name: tsp
fields.description: temporary stack pointer for frame and root records
fields.update: generated code; checkpointed by every frame

fields.name: tsp_base
fields.description: owned temporary-stack region start

fields.name: tsp_limit
fields.description: owned temporary-stack region end

fields.name: csp
fields.description: control stack pointer for handler and cleanup records
fields.update: generated code; checkpointed by every frame

fields.name: csp_base
fields.description: owned control-stack region start

fields.name: csp_limit
fields.description: owned control-stack region end

fields.name: stack_reserve_bytes
fields.description: capacity kept in reserve on each explicit stack for the condition path after a checked exhaustion

fields.name: tlb_pointer
fields.description: thread-local binding vector; indexed by a symbol's binding index, not by tcr_index
fields.update: thread on binding-vector growth under admission

fields.name: tlb_limit
fields.description: binding-vector capacity in entries

fields.name: db_link
fields.description: head of the special-binding chain; the frame binding checkpoint
fields.update: generated code on bind/unbind; restored on every exit path

fields.name: mv_count
fields.description: count of the live extra values in the owned VSP result region
fields.update: callee on return; reset with the descriptor before any stop

fields.name: mv_base
fields.description: caller-owned VSP result region; no separate backing buffer

fields.name: mv_owner_top
fields.description: extent of the owned result region; exactly one scanner per physical slot

fields.name: root_head
fields.description: head of the published root-record chain; complete before every legal stopping boundary
fields.update: thread at publication; collector updates the tagged slots the records point at

fields.name: frame_head
fields.description: head of the logical frame chain (contracts/debug-frames.md)
fields.update: generated code at frame push/pop; restored on every exit path

fields.name: frame_generation
fields.description: next logical frame generation; exhaustion refused

fields.name: handler_checkpoint
fields.description: head of the handler and cleanup record chain
fields.update: generated code; restored on every exit path

fields.name: foreign_descriptor
fields.description: published root-frame/foreign-call descriptor while FOREIGN; zero otherwise
fields.update: thread before entering FOREIGN; cleared after admission and root reload

fields.name: unwind_state
fields.description: exception transfer in progress; distinguishes ordinary and nonlocal exits during cleanup

fields.name: active_request
fields.description: address of the descriptor currently waited on, or zero; interrupt delivery targets it
fields.update: thread saves/restores around nested waits; restored by the nonlocal-exit adapter

fields.name: request_block_base
fields.description: owned stable request descriptors; the host writes only inside them

fields.name: request_count
fields.description: number of owned descriptors

fields.name: mailbox_id
fields.description: identity the host uses to notify this thread's status words

fields.name: c_stack_pointer
fields.description: C stack pointer saved at the emitted/C boundary; restored on ordinary and exceptional exit

fields.name: tls_base
fields.description: per-Worker C TLS region start

fields.name: tls_size
fields.description: per-Worker C TLS region size

fields.name: scratch0
fields.description: runtime-private unboxed scratch word; never a root

fields.name: scratch1
fields.description: runtime-private unboxed scratch word; never a root

fields.name: next_method_context
fields.description: tagged method context for CLOS dispatch; NIL until Stage 1 uses it

fields.name: error_service_mode
fields.description: EARLY while only the fatal diagnostic path exists, FULL after ordinary error services activate

fields.name: debug_policy
fields.description: debug availability policy for logical frames
